notes: Helper t_cnt is the index of the cycle ending at the sampled edge, reset to 0 at each command handshake. CPOL_b and last are captured at the handshake. CHK-026 runs without disable iff so that it also covers reset (SPI-6.2-03). It is sampled only at posedge i_clk, because the required assertion format has no falling-edge or same-time-step sampling. "No change between clock edges" (CHK-024) is likewise checked only at posedge. Not compiled or simulated.
